answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 176 identities means 176 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the yarrow pair is tracked in the glacier ledger, the ferrous audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
